description: This source file defines a class `PartyServices` which provides multiple static service methods for managing parties, persons, party groups, affiliates, notes, and related entities within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating, updating, and retrieving parties and their associations, along with handling business logic related to party statuses, types, and contact mechanisms.

classes.name: PartyServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static service methods for party-related operations in OFBiz.

methods.name: createPerson
methods.description: Creates a new person party with optional partyId. Generates a unique partyId if not provided, and ensures the party is of type 'PERSON'. Also creates the party status history.

methods.name: setPartyStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a party, ensuring status changes are valid and recording the change in the party status history. Disables user logins if party is disabled.

methods.name: updatePerson
methods.description: Updates an existing person party and its associated party entity. Also can trigger a status change if specified.

methods.name: createPartyGroup
methods.description: Creates a party group entity, optionally creating the underlying party if it doesn't exist, with appropriate party type and status.

methods.name: updatePartyGroup
methods.description: Updates a party group entity and its associated party. Also handles status change via separate service call.

methods.name: createAffiliate
methods.description: Creates an affiliate associated with a party, ensuring no duplicate affiliate exists.

methods.name: updateAffiliate
methods.description: Updates details of an existing affiliate entity.

methods.name: createPartyNote
methods.description: Creates a note and associates it with a party, creating the note if necessary.

methods.name: getPartiesFromExactEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a list of parties associated with an email address, matching exactly.

methods.name: getPartiesFromPartOfEmail
methods.description: Retrieves parties associated with an email substring.

methods.name: getPartiesFromPartOfUserloginId
methods.description: Retrieves parties linked to a user login ID, supporting partial matches.

methods.name: getPartiesFromPerson
methods.description: Retrieves parties matching first and/or last name criteria.

methods.name: getPartiesFromPartyGroup
methods.description: Retrieves parties associated with a party group name.

methods.name: getPartiesFromExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves parties matching an externalId.

methods.name: getPerson
methods.description: Retrieves the person entity associated with a given partyId.

methods.name: findParty
methods.description: A deprecated method for party lookup that retrieves role types, current role, party types, and geo info, possibly for UI or form population.

methods.name: linkParty
methods.description: Changes the association of contact mechs, purposes, notes, orders, and attributes from one party to another for merging, and disables the original party.

methods.name: importAddressMatchMapCsv
methods.description: Imports address matching rules from a CSV file and stores them in the AddressMatchMap entity.

methods.name: getPartyId
methods.description: Retrieves partyId from context or the current user login if not explicitly provided.

methods.name: findPartyById
methods.description: Finds partyId(s) associated with a party reference, partyId, or GoodIdentification idValue, supporting flexible search criteria.

methods.name: importParty
methods.description: Imports party data from a CSV file, creating or updating party, contact mechanisms, roles, and relationships, with extensive validation.
